tests.title: The poll starts after the jobs layer and starts one loop per subscribed workspace
given: a temporary database with subscriptions widgets and gadgets
a recording start hook on the jobs layer and on the poll supervisor
tests.when: agent-fox's start sequence runs
then: the poll supervisor start is recorded after the jobs layer start
exactly one loop exists for widgets and one for gadgets
tests.pseudocode: start(); assert order.index('poll') > order.index('jobs'); assert loops == {'widgets':1,'gadgets':1}

tests.title: A subscription scan starts a loop for a new subscription and never a second loop for an existing one
given: the supervisor running with a scan period of 60 s on an injected clock
widgets subscribed and polled
tests.when: gadgets is subscribed, the clock advances 60 s twice
then: gadgets gets exactly one loop
widgets still has exactly one loop
the first poll of gadgets happens within one scan period plus the first-cycle delay
tests.pseudocode: subscribe('gadgets'); clock.advance(60s); clock.advance(60s); assert loopCount('gadgets')==1 and loopCount('widgets')==1

tests.title: Unsubscribing stops the loop and cancels an in-flight cycle
given: widgets subscribed, a cycle in flight held by a fake hub delay on the list request
tests.when: the subscription is deleted from the store and the next scan runs
then: the in-flight cycle's context is cancelled
the loop is gone
the fake hub records no further request with the widgets PAT after the scan
tests.pseudocode: hub.delay('issues'); startCycle(); store.delete('widgets'); scan(); n=hub.count(pat); clock.advance(1h); assert hub.count(pat)==n

tests.title: First cycle waits the injected delay, later cycles start one interval after the previous ended, and cycles never overlap
given: a first-cycle delay source returning 17 s
a fake hub whose list request takes 2 minutes of injected clock
AF_POLL_INTERVAL 2m
tests.when: the clock advances for 20 minutes
then: the first cycle starts at 17 s
each later cycle starts 2 minutes after the previous cycle ended
at most one cycle of widgets is in flight at any time
the default delay source only ever yields values in [0,30s]
tests.pseudocode: record start/end times; assert start[i+1]-end[i]==2m; assert maxConcurrent==1; for _ in 1000: assert 0<=defaultDelay()<=30s

tests.title: At most four cycles run at once across workspaces
given: six subscribed workspaces
a fake hub that holds every variables read until released
first-cycle delay zero
tests.when: all six cycles become due together
then: exactly four variables reads are in flight
the other two wait
when one is released a waiting cycle starts
the in-flight count never exceeds 4
tests.pseudocode: assert hub.inflight()==4; release(1); wait; assert hub.inflight()==4 and hub.started==5

tests.title: A cycle running for 5 minutes is cancelled, keeps what it did and frees its slot
given: af:triage on issue 7 and af:fix on issue 42
the fake hub answers the fix list only after hanging
the triage job for 7 already created and its label removed
tests.when: the injected clock advances 5 minutes while the fix list hangs
then: the cycle context is cancelled at 5 minutes
the triage job and the removal of af:triage stand
the slot is free for another workspace
the next cycle starts after the interval the workspace last read
tests.pseudocode: clock.advance(5m); assert ctx.err==Canceled; assert jobs.count==1; assert slots.free==4; assert nextStart==now+lastInterval

tests.title: Shutdown starts no new cycle, cancels cycles in flight and returns before the jobs layer stops
given: a cycle in flight held on hub
recording stop hooks on the poll and on the jobs layer
tests.when: agent-fox begins shutdown
then: the in-flight cycle is cancelled
the poll's stop call returns before the jobs layer's stop is called
advancing the clock afterwards starts no cycle
tests.pseudocode: shutdown(); assert order==['poll.stop returned','jobs.stop called']; clock.advance(1h); assert hub.count()==before

tests.title: The supervisor defaults to wall clock, random 0-30 s delay, 60 s scan and 5 minute release delay, and accepts injected values
given: a supervisor built with no options
a supervisor built with injected clock, delay, scan period and release delay
tests.when: the effective configuration is read
then: defaults are wall clock, a delay in [0,30s], scan period 60 s, release delay 5 minutes
injected values replace each default
tests.pseudocode: d=New(); assert d.scan==60s and d.release==5m and d.clock is time.Now; i=New(opts); assert i.scan==injected

tests.title: Unset AF_POLL_INTERVAL polls 5 minutes apart and 2m polls 2 minutes apart
given: workspace widgets with AF_POLL_INTERVAL unset on the fake hub
tests.when: the clock advances through several cycles, then the variable is set to 2m and the clock advances again
then: with the variable unset, list requests are 5 minutes apart
after the change to 2m, list requests are 2 minutes apart
24h is accepted as 24h and 1m as 1m

tests.title: A zero interval disables listing but the variable is read every 5 minutes

tests.title: An invalid AF_POLL_INTERVAL falls back to 5 minutes with one WARN per distinct value

with none read, the next cycle starts 5 minutes later
tests.pseudocode: assert nextStart(after_2m)==end+2m; assert nextStart(after_0)==end+5m; assert nextStart(none)==end+5m
